notes:
NoDraw 0.1.0 beta 6 hotfix for Windows x64

- Fixed a crash when resetting an entity property with the × button while editing its value. Resetting Pitch Yaw Roll clears the rotation and can be undone.
- **Split Polygon Brushes** divides complex Polygon extrusions into brushes with three- or four-edge outlines, preserving their exterior materials, UVs, volume and grouping.
- **Tie Each Brush to Entity** creates one entity per selected world brush. Choose the class from the viewport context menu, including `func_detail_blocker`.

Installed beta 5 builds can update through Help → Check for updates.

[NoDraw documentation](https://env-snake.github.io/nodraw-site/)
